sentences.text: The contention of the petitioner is that the case is of the year 2014, it took almost 9 years for the respondent police to conclude the investigation and filed a charge sheet and thereafter, now the case has been periodically adjourned, without any progress for more than a year.
Hence, the petitioner filed this Petition.
4. The learned Additional Public Prosecutor submitted that it is a case of forgery.
Hence, the documents have to be collected and there is a dispute among Trust members.
The accused persons were erstwhile trustees and the defacto complainant is the present trustee.
It is a rival dispute among the erstwhile and present trustees.

In this case, A4 died and the same was informed to the trial Court on 13.09.2023 and thereafter, the case was adjourned to 11.10.2023 and on that date, the death certificate https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Crl.O.P.(MD)No.19414 of 2024 had been produced and the same has been recorded and
now, it is informed that A5 also died and the case has been adjourned periodically for producing death certificate of A5 and the case against A1 to A3 and A6 can be proceeded.
In this case, there are 8 witnesses and within a stipulated time, the trial itself can be completed.

5. Considering the submission and material records, this Court directs the trial Court to give priority to the case in C.C.No.292 of 2023, not giving long adjournment, to complete the trial within a period of six months from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
6.
With the above direction, this Criminal Original Petition is disposed of.
